newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Rato sees private consumption recovering.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rato sees private consumption recovering.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Monday that private consumption was recovering clearly and solidly, helped by a moderation in price rises and market deregulation.
"We are in a clear recovery of private consumption," he said at the close of an economic seminar.
He added that the recovery of private consumption was not cyclical and that it was recovering at rates above other European countries.
